! JO9 MOD START AUDIO_FORMAT_SAVE_PATHS_20261108
if $args[0]='path':
 local $jo9_audio_norm

 $result=$args[1]
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/abus_theme.wav': $result='content/snd/Abus_theme.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/agraba.wav': $result='content/snd/Agraba.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/agraba_intro.wav': $result='content/snd/Agraba_intro.mp3'

 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/citadel.wav': $result='content/snd/citadel.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/city_citizen.wav': $result='content/snd/city_citizen.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/city_honor.wav': $result='content/snd/city_honor.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/city_poor.wav': $result='content/snd/city_poor.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/fight_arena.wav': $result='content/snd/fight_arena.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/fight_girl.wav': $result='content/snd/fight_girl.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/fight_master.wav': $result='content/snd/fight_master.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/fog.wav': $result='content/snd/fog.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/home.wav': $result='content/snd/home.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/home_badmood.wav': $result='content/snd/home_badmood.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/home_goodmood.wav': $result='content/snd/home_goodmood.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/home_verybadmood.wav': $result='content/snd/home_verybadmood.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/home_verygoodmood.wav': $result='content/snd/home_verygoodmood.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/jafars_theme.wav': $result='content/snd/Jafars_theme.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/mainscreen.wav': $result='content/snd/mainscreen.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/night.wav': $result='content/snd/night.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/palace.wav': $result='content/snd/palace.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/patrician_credits.wav': $result='content/snd/patrician_credits.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/race_master.wav': $result='content/snd/race_master.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/rajas_theme.wav': $result='content/snd/Rajas_theme.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/rasuls_theme.wav': $result='content/snd/Rasuls_theme.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/spires.wav': $result='content/snd/spires.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/stealing_the_lamp.wav': $result='content/snd/Stealing_the_lamp.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/tower.wav': $result='content/snd/tower.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/vatican.wav': $result='content/snd/vatican.mp3'
 if $jo9_audio_norm='content/snd/city.wav': $result='content/snd/city.mp3'
 exit
end
local jo9_audio_i
local $jo9_audio_old, $jo9_audio_new
for jo9_audio_i=0 to arrsize('$music')-1:
 $music[jo9_audio_i]=$func('jo9_audio_formats','path',$music[jo9_audio_i])
end
$fogs_options[2]=replace($fogs_options[2],'fight_master.wav','fight_master.mp3')
$display_options[2]=replace($display_options[2],'fight_master.wav','fight_master.mp3')
$jo9_audio_old=$music_now
$jo9_audio_new=$func('jo9_audio_formats','path',$music_now)
if $jo9_audio_old!$jo9_audio_new:
 $music_now=$jo9_audio_new
 if sound_on=1 and $music_now!'':
  play $music_now,music_volume,'only, loop'
 else
  close $jo9_audio_old
 end
end
